applicability.rationale: The selected submission-readiness criterion applies to the manuscript, although the supplied record contains no format-compliance details.
The manuscript concerns learning analytics, consistent with the declared target context.
The manuscript reports a computational model and documents feature definitions and code.
The study spans classroom settings whose implementation differs by site.
The manuscript makes a pooled cross-site conclusion from synthetic study materials.

evidence_anchor.claim: Implementation differs by site, yet the main conclusion pools sites; the limitations do not connect institutional variation to delivery or interpretation, and no site-specific calibration table is provided.

remedy.cost_tradeoffs: Requires additional site-stratified reporting and qualification of the pooled interpretation; may make cross-site conclusions more conditional.
remedy.minimum_action: Report site-specific calibration and describe the site-level implementation differences relevant to interpreting pooled performance; revise the pooled conclusion to reflect any resulting uncertainty.

findings.scholarly_relevance: Without linking site context to interpretation of pooled performance, readers cannot determine whether similar discrimination supports a common cross-site interpretation.
